title: 第7章 好一个舍生取义的少年俊彦！！！

content_zh:
拳风戛然而止，拳头距离苏景的额头已经只有方寸，燕南天愤怒的面容显露眼前，“小子，你什么意思？！”
“来不及了，我们骑马过去，边走边说！！！”
苏景唇角溢出一丝鲜血，果然移花接玉有反震之力，这才用了一回，便觉的浑身如烈火焚烧，好在他十年锻骨，骨骼无比坚韧，不然，恐怕已经堆崴在地了！
强忍着内脏的剧痛，他抛出了一颗明珠，对着小二喝道：“小二，速速给我买一匹好马去，爷满意了，还有大好处给你！！！”
小二手忙脚乱的接过了苏景扔过来的银珠，眼睛里闪起了贪婪的光芒，讨好的笑道：“是是是，爷请稍待，小的这就去买马！”
燕南天怒喝道：“为何买马？某家轻功岂非胜过马匹数倍？”
“但我可没有你的轻功，而且你也必须养精蓄锐才行！”
苏景认真道：“你是对抗邀月唯一的希望，决不能消耗真气！”
“你还没有跟某家解释为何你会移花宫的移花接玉？！！！”
“来不及了，路上说！！！”
七天，如今已经过去了两天，不知道江枫到底怎样，但苏景知道……既然是自己的试炼，就不能有半点侥幸的心思！
苏景终于知道，为何那么多人参加这所谓的主神试炼，却全都失败了。
自己并不会武功，都能摊上邀月这等高人，若非自己对剧情无比了解，换了一个什么都不知道的人，单单想要从邀月手下活下来，便已经是天下第一的难事，纵然一时侥幸活了下来，他又如何知晓燕南天是对抗邀月的唯一希望？
纵然知晓，嫁衣神功的弱点，他又如何知晓？贸贸然的带着燕南天冲上去，只能是死路一条！！！
………………………………………………
荒僻的小路上，两匹俊逸的骏马脚步哒哒的冲过……留下一地尘烟！
而此时，马上的两个人正在交谈！
苏景把自己路上被邀月截下的事情告之了燕南天，而后又将自己主动要求学习移花接玉和明玉功的事情说了出来……
他没有说这是自己为了增强自己的手段，而是很大义凛然的解释道：“邀月这女人疑心十足，我虽然以计策蒙骗了她，但若不让她在我身上下个保险，恐怕她绝不会让我活着找到燕大侠，没办法，为了公子的安危，所以我不得不……”
正说着，燕南天突然一勒马缰，骏马仰天嘶鸣，直接停了下来！

苏景一愣，也紧跟着手忙脚乱的停了下来！
燕南天一把拉过了苏景，苏景如今虽然只有十六七岁年纪，身体基本已经长成，但在燕南天面前，竟然还只是跟个小孩子一般……整个人毫无反抗能力的被他拽下了马来！
随后……
一股极为灼热的真气从燕南天手中发出，在苏景的体内转了一圈，侦查他体内的情况……
太过灼热暴虐的真气，直接激发了苏景体内明玉异种真气的反击。
冷热相激！
苏景忍不住腹内如刀绞一般，一口鲜血吐了出来！
他强忍剧痛，半点也没哼出来！
燕南天放下手，咬牙怒道：“好毒的妖妇，你体内筋脉如今寸寸皆断，全靠明玉真气维续，她竟然让你真的活不过七日！！！”
本来对苏景的敌意也尽数放下，看向他的眼神，已经是看着一个大义凛然，甘愿为他人牺牲自己的义士，燕南天歉然道：“抱歉了江琴，之前是某家太激动了！”
“无妨，燕大侠也是为了义弟性命！我可以理解……”
苏景道：“我们快走吧，有什么事情路上说！”、
“好！”
两人重新上马，继续向前奔驰，而途中，苏景继续道：“邀月太难对付，所以我另有打算……”
“莫非你是让我杀了弟妹？！”
想起之前面前这个少年告之自己的话，那阴险的计谋，若他真的是敌人，恐怕自己真的会被他蒙蔽，犯下不可饶恕的错误！
一想起自己和义弟多年的感情，险些便要毁于一旦，燕南天心底便潸潸都是冷汗，只觉得，人心怎么都这么狠毒？！当真不给我们老实人半点活路……
可现在，这个往日里自己看来并不如何出众，如今却可舍生取义的义士，怎么却给自己出了这么个注意？

content_en:
The punch suddenly stopped, and the fist was only a square inch away from Su Jing's forehead. Yan Nantian's angry face appeared in front of him, "Boy, what do you mean?!"
"It's too late, let's ride over and talk as we go!!!"
A trace of blood overflowed from the corner of Su Jing's lips. Sure enough, the power of moving flowers and jade can counteract the shock. After using it once, he felt like his whole body was burning. Fortunately, after ten years of bone training, his bones were extremely tough. Otherwise, he would have been piled on the ground!
Holding back the severe pain in his internal organs, he threw out a bright pearl and shouted to the waiter: "Xiao Er, buy me a good horse quickly. I am satisfied, and I will give you big benefits!!!"
The little second-hand man hurriedly took the silver beads thrown by Su Jing, his eyes flashed with greed, and he said with a flattering smile: "Yes, yes, yes, sir, please wait a moment, I will go buy a horse now!"
Yan Nantian shouted angrily: "Why buy a horse? Isn't a certain family's qinggong several times better than a horse?"
"But I don't have your Qinggong skills, and you have to recharge your batteries!"
Su Jing said seriously: "You are the only hope against Yao Yue, you must not waste your true energy!"
"You haven't explained to a certain family why you moved flowers and jade in Yihua Palace?!!!"
"It's too late, I told you on the way!!!"
Seven days, and now two days have passed. I don’t know how Jiang Feng is doing, but Su Jing knows... Since it is his trial, he can’t take any chances!
Su Jing finally understood why so many people participated in this so-called Lord God Trial, but all failed.
He doesn't know martial arts, but he can compete with a master like Yao Yue. If he didn't know the plot very well, it would be the most difficult thing in the world to survive from Yao Yue if he were someone who didn't know anything. Even if he was lucky enough to survive for a while, how would he know that Yan Nantian was the only hope against Yao Yue?
Even if he knew the weakness of the Wedding Clothes Divine Art, how could he know about it? Rushing forward with Yan Nantian rashly will lead to a dead end! ! !
…………………………………………
On a remote road, two elegant horses rushed past... leaving behind a trail of dust and smoke!
At this time, the two people on the horse were talking!
Su Jing told Yan Nantian about being intercepted by Yaoyue on the road, and then told Yan Nantian about his initiative to learn the techniques of transferring flowers and jade and Mingyu...
He did not say that this was a way to strengthen himself, but explained in a righteous manner: "Yao Yue is a very suspicious woman. Although I deceived her with my tricks, if I don't let her take insurance on me, I'm afraid she will never let me find the hero Yan alive. There is no other way, for the safety of the young master, so I have to..."
Just as he was talking, Yan Nantian suddenly reined in the horse, and the horse looked up to the sky and neighed, then stopped!
Su Jing was stunned for a moment, then hurriedly stopped!
Yan Nantian pulled Su Jing over. Although Su Jing was only sixteen or seventeen years old and his body had basically grown, in front of Yan Nantian, he was still just like a child... He was dragged off the horse without any resistance!
Then...
A stream of extremely hot Qi came out of Yan Nantian's hand and circulated around Su Jing's body, detecting the situation inside his body...
The too hot and violent Qi directly inspired the counterattack of Mingyu's alien Qi in Su Jing's body.
Hot and cold clash!
Su Jing couldn't help but feel like a knife was twisting in his stomach, and he vomited out a mouthful of blood!
He endured the severe pain without humming at all!
Yan Nantian put down his hand, gritted his teeth and said angrily: "Vicious witch, every inch of your body's veins and veins are now severed. It's all thanks to Mingyu's true energy that you can't survive for seven days!!!"
The original hostility towards Su Jing was put aside. When he looked at him, he already looked at a righteous man who was upright and willing to sacrifice himself for others. Yan Nantian said apologetically: "I'm sorry Jiang Qin, a certain family was too excited earlier."Got it! "
"It doesn't matter, Hero Yan is also for his sworn brother's life! I can understand..."
Su Jingdao: "Let's leave quickly, let's talk about anything on the way! ",
"good! "
The two remounted their horses and continued to gallop forward. On the way, Su Jing continued: "Yao Yue is too difficult to deal with, so I have other plans..."
"Could it be that you asked me to kill my sister-in-law? ! "
Thinking back to what the young man in front of me told me about his insidious plan, if he was really an enemy, I might be deceived by him and make an unforgivable mistake!
Thinking of the relationship between himself and his adopted brother that had almost been destroyed in one day, Yan Nantian broke out in a cold sweat. He just thought, why are people so cruel? ! They really don’t give us honest people any way to survive...
But now, why did this righteous man who didn't seem to be very outstanding in the past, but was now willing to sacrifice his life for righteousness, pay such attention to himself?
